title: Inline Edit
summary: Click-to-edit text that keeps your draft when a save fails or you cancel, and warns when someone else changed the value mid-edit.
description: Click-to-edit text: a cancelled edit can be restored, a failed save keeps your draft, and a value changed by someone else mid-edit is flagged instead of silently overwritten (clicking away then keeps the editor open rather than saving).
catches: Edit thrown away by Escape: a Restore button brings it back
Save failure: the draft is kept and the error shown
Value changed elsewhere while you edit: conflict shown with Use theirs
limits: Conflict detection compares the value prop; it needs your app to push remote changes into it
Not a merge tool: you choose one version
No offline queue for failed saves
a11y: The read view is a button whose aria-label names the field, current value and Edit
Input has an aria-label, aria-invalid on error and a hint in a polite live region
Enter saves and Escape cancels; focus returns to the trigger after closing
